text:
jordan_support: Hey team — customer acct_8f3a reports promo code redeemed (code=WELCOME50) shows success in the UI but their credit balance is still 0 and API requests are hitting quota errors. Redemption id: redeem_98765. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/acct_8f3a/promos

billing-bot: Promo redemption processed: redeem_98765 for acct_8f3a, amount=50 credits, status=queued_for_ledger_apply at 2026-03-02T15:21:30Z

devon_billing: @jordan_support can you paste the output of `billing-cli ledger get --account acct_8f3a --last 20`? I want to see if the ledger entry exists or if apply job errored. Also need the user email if possible.

jordan_support: sure, customer email is lexi@example.com. pasted ledger output below:
```
LEDGER: acct_8f3a
- 2026-03-02T15:21:30Z promo_redeem redeem_98765 queued_for_ledger_apply
- 2026-03-02T15:21:31Z promo_redeem redeem_98765 apply_attempt failed: ConstraintError(duplicate_key)
```

maria_engineer: thanks. looks like the apply job tried to write but hit a DB uniqueness constraint and aborted, so the promotion record exists but the corresponding credit ledger row didn't get created. likely a replay/backfill will fix. I'm going to check the payments-worker logs for the apply-promo job id tied to redeem_98765.

maria_engineer: logs snippet:
```
ERROR payments-worker applyPromo: redeem_98765 ConstraintError: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "promo_redemptions_pkey" at applyPromo (/srv/payments/apply.js:214)
stack: ...
```

devon_billing: if it's the pkey on promo_redemptions then the redemption record is already present (good). The missing step is the ledger insertion. We can safely re-run the small apply job that inserts the ledger row; @finance-ops should approve a manual downstream adjustment if we need to avoid customer impact while we replay.

oliver_cs: Customer is blocked on a demo today. We should offer interim workaround: manual 50-credit top-up and note we may reverse if auto-apply later double-applies. I'll apologize and offer a short extension if needed.

finance-ops: FYI finance ops checking. Can you confirm the promo amount? We see amount=50 in billing-bot. We'll do a manual ledger adjustment but need a trace id and thumbs-up from eng to avoid race.

maria_engineer: trace id: trace_apply_redeem_98765_20260302. I'm going to attempt a targeted replay of the apply job: `payments-worker replay --job apply-promo --id redeem_98765 --force` — this should only create the missing ledger row, it will detect the redemption pkey and skip duplicate writes where appropriate. I'll run it in 5 mins and monitor.

jordan_support: approved by finance, go ahead. I'll tell customer we're investigating and will apply a manual top-up if needed.

maria_engineer: running replay now...
```
$ payments-worker replay --job apply-promo --id redeem_98765 --force
INFO replay started for redeem_98765
INFO created ledger_row id=lr_66431 amount=50 applied_by=payments-worker
INFO replay completed
```

billing-bot: Ledger update recorded: ledger_row lr_66431 linked to redeem_98765 amount=50 credits applied at 2026-03-02T15:28:40Z

finance-ops: Manual adjustment logged and matched to redemption id redeem_98765. Posting 50 credits to acct_8f3a now. We'll keep a note to reconcile later if system also auto-applies.

jordan_support: I can confirm the customer's balance now shows 50 credits and their API calls succeed. Customer thanked us and resumed demo.

oliver_cs: great. please post a brief note for postmortem — looks like we need better idempotency handling in apply job to avoid ConstraintError causing no-ledger state. Also consider a small health-check that alerts when redemption_status != ledger_row_exists.

maria_engineer: filed infra ticket INF-1421 for idempotency fix and INF-1422 for redemption/ledger mismatch alerting. I'll add retry logic and add a dogfood monitor.

jordan_support: thanks all — closing thread. :tada:
